 What we offer: 
 At Magna, you can expect an engaging and dynamic environment where you can help to develop industry-leading automotive technologies. We invest in our employees, providing them with the support and resources they need to succeed. As a member of our global team, you can expect exciting, varied responsibilities as well as a wide range of development prospects. Because we believe that your career path should be as unique as you are.
 
 
 
 
 
 Group Summary: 
 Magna is more than one of the world’s largest suppliers in the automotive space. We are a mobility technology company built to innovate, with a global, entrepreneurial-minded team. With 65+ years of expertise, our ecosystem of interconnected products combined with our complete vehicle expertise uniquely positions us to advance mobility in an expanded transportation landscape. 
 
 
 
 

 
 Job Responsibilities: 







 Job Introduction: 

 Magna Corporate R&D in Troy, MI is seeking a talented, visionary, and self-motivated AI Engineer to be a part of the Factory of the Future Vision & Data Analytics Group, which will create new applications leveraging data analytics, AI and ML to improve overall efficiencies at Magna divisions. The ideal candidate will have broad and deep experience with theoretical approaches and practical implementations of data analytics, AI and ML methods, machine vision and deployment frameworks. They will understand the process of concept, design, build, and launch of these applications and the reporting process to various stakeholders. The ideal candidate will enjoy working in a culture that fosters creativity and problem solving. This position will play a key role in the Data Analytics Group and be a part of a tightly knit development team that creates, validates, and implements Factory of the Future solutions. 
   
 Major Responsibilities:  
 Support the development and implementation of short- and long-term R&D objectives and technology roadmaps.  
 Conduct research programs applying theory and principles of data analytics, AI and ML and machine vision. Guide programs and establish scientific and technical directions. 
 Contribute to the development of novel algorithms and technology platforms, as well as the integration of systems & subsystems with different technologies and apply them internally at Magna divisions. 
 Interface with SW engineering, product management, and/or program management to drive new product development programs from concept to production. 
 Utilize software development and process tools for requirements management, architecture and design, modeling, simulation, testing, and configuration management and release management. 
 Maintain project schedules by monitoring project progress, coordinating activities and sub-contracted work, estimating timing needs and hurdles, sequencing project elements, and resolving problems, thus assuring timely completion. Prepare and present project progress reports. 
 Pursue education and/or training in data analytics and simulation technologies as fields evolve. Keep the organization abreast of program developments, new technical methods, and recommended changes warranted by such developments. Apply updated information to the Data Analytics Technology roadmap.  
 Analyze research, third-party offerings, and competitor’s technologies to determine feasibility for Magna use. 
 Comply with the designated ISO / TS 16949 responsibilities, Health & Safety (H&S) rules and practices, and Magna policies, procedures, and practices.    
 Perform any other duties, special projects, and tasks as assigned 
 
 Knowledge and Education: 
 BS/MS/PhD in electrical, mechanical, computer engineering, computer science or equivalent progressive experience in discipline with appropriate focus 
 Advanced knowledge of Python, SQL and other common programming languages 
 Understanding of ROS/ROS2 & robotics frameworks 
 Experience with AWS, Azure environment and tools for data ingestion, cleaning, processing, deployment and monitoring 
 Familiar with ML frameworks and popular packages such as Caret (R), Scikitlearn, TensorFlow, Flask (Python), Docker, Git,  
 Experience with model deployment as API (REST/SOAP) and configuration of the API 
 Familiar with MLops tools such as MLflow, Kubeflow, TFX, etc 
 Experience with tools and data ingestion protocols – MQTT, OPC, etc;  
 Experience with machine vision tools, libraries and methods 
 Experience with PowerBI, Tableau, Grafana for visualization and BI 
 Knowledge of Manufacturing Process, Assembly methods and materials used in automotive products 
 
 Work Experience:  
 Minimum 2-3 years in a related area, or equivalent combination of education/experience in the field of applied machine learning, AI, computer engineering or similar 
 Functional knowledge of data analytics in a manufacturing environment 
 Functional experience working with static and dynamic, structured and unstructured data in manufacturing environment 
 Experience with industrial control systems, specifically automotive line control applications 
 Understanding of Magna manufacturing and assembly processes 
 
 Skills and Competencies:  
 Strong spoken and written English language skills. Additional languages skills desired (German, Spanish, etc.) 
 Ability to apply advanced principles, theories, and concepts, and contribute to the development of solutions to complex problems that require innovation and ingenuity 
 Ability to recognize new science and technologies relevant within existing trends and business strategy and extend them into new applications 
 Technical ability and creativity to initiate, and manage specific projects with diverse stakeholders 
 Ability to contribute to a performing team 
 
 Work Environment: 

 While performing the duties of this job, the employee is regularly required to talk and hear and use hands to finger, handle, and feel. The employee is required to reach with hands and arms and have adequate mobility to stand, walk, sit, stoop, kneel, crouch, or crawl. The employee must occasionally lift and/or move up to fifty (50) pounds. Specific vision abilities required by this job include close vision and ability to adjust focus.  
 Ability to travel domestic and international up to 25%  
 Responsible for working in compliance with the provisions of the Health and Safety Act as well as any rules or standards otherwise specified by OSHA, MIOSHA, or any other government regulations. Expected to exercise caution in all work activities and report any unsafe conditions, injuries, or near misses to the appropriate supervisor. 
 Awareness, Unity, Empowerment: 
 At Magna, we believe that a diverse workforce is critical to our success. That’s why we are proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We hire on the basis of experience and qualifications, and in consideration of job requirements, regardless of, in particular, color, ancestry, religion, gender, origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability or gender identity. Magna takes the privacy of your personal information seriously. We discourage you from sending applications via email or traditional mail to comply with GDPR requirements and your local Data Privacy Law.

 
 AI-Assisted Screening Disclosure 
 As part of our commitment to a fair, consistent, and efficient recruitment process, we may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to assist in the initial screening of applications submitted through our Workday system. These tools help identify qualifications and experience that align with the role requirements. Please note that AI is used solely to support our recruiters. Final decisions are always made by the hiring manager and the hiring team. Importantly, no applicant data is shared externally through these AI tools. All information remains securely within our systems and is handled in accordance with our privacy and data protection policies.

 Under conditions defined by applicable law, you may have the right to request an explanation of how AI is used to support decision-making. 
 If you have any questions or concerns about this process, feel free to contact our Talent Attraction team.
